context: We have presented update algorithms for maintaining barcodes over a changing zigzag filtration. Two main questions come out of this research: (i) The representatives for the barcodes are maintained only in the up-down filtrations. An open question that remains is whether this can help maintain the representatives for the original zigzag filtration in quadratic time over all operations. (ii) Are there other interesting applications of the update algorithms presented in this paper? Their applications to computing vineyards for dynamic point clouds, multiparameter persistence, and dynamic network are mentioned in [6, 16]. We hope that there are other dynamic settings which can benefit from efficient zigzag updates.
